name: bulk-write-gate
what: A SQL write that would change every row of a table is refused unless the statement carries a bulk-ok comment with a reason.

faults.fault: A WHERE clause that is always true, such as 1=1, is accepted as a real filter.
The bulk-ok comment is ignored, so an approved statement is still refused.
Protected tables are never matched, so their updates and deletes pass.
git commands are no longer exempt, so a commit message that mentions SQL is refused.
TRUNCATE is no longer recognised as a bulk write.
